_editing: The FAQ page. Each entry is one question; `answer` holds paragraphs, `items` an optional bullet list, and `links` the 'find it here' links that follow. A link with `to` points inside this site; one with `href` points out to an external site and opens in a new tab. The three City of Toronto links below point at the City's elections hub — if the campaign has the exact deep links for the voters' list, registration and candidate list, paste them into `href` and nothing else needs changing.
title: Frequently asked questions
lede: Voting dates, registering on the voters' list, and where to read more.

items.question: When is the election?
items: Advance voting — October 6 to October 11, 10 AM to 7 PM
Election day — October 26, 10 AM to 8 PM

items.question: How do I make sure I can vote in the next municipal election?
answer: Check that you are on the voters' list, and that your information is current.

items.question: How do I register on the voters' list?
answer: You can register as an eligible voter for the October 2026 election with the City of Toronto.

items.question: Where can I learn more about Ketan?
answer: His background, why he is running, and his priorities as trustee.

items.question: Where can I learn more about the other candidates?
answer: The names of the candidates running in this year's TDSB Trustee election in Ward 12 are published by the City of Toronto.
